userStories.notes: DEFERRED to P4. apps/web/src/components/detail-panel.tsx (lines 1-7) imports the REST functions `openProjectFile` + `revealProjectFile` from `@/lib/api` and calls them inside the `HtmlNodeSection.dispatch` helper (lines 451-471 — the Open-in-editor / Reveal buttons POST to `/api/projects/<id>/files`). Those two helpers are defined in `apps/web/src/lib/api.ts:531` (`openProjectFile`) and `apps/web/src/lib/api.ts:539` (`revealProjectFile`); both wrap a `requestFileAction` private helper that fetches `/api/projects/.../files`. Per the story's second acceptance criterion this is the textbook 'calls REST functions from @/lib/api' deferral case — moving now would require leaking project-scoped REST URLs into canvas or duplicating the file-action transport, both undone by P4's CanvasAdapter (US-024 onward). The type-only imports on those same lines (`Connector`, `DemoNode`, `StatusReport`) and the canvas-side imports (`Button`, `Sheet*`, `StatusBadge`, `cn`, `getStoredDetailPanelWidth`/`setStoredDetailPanelWidth`, `startResizeGesture`) all resolve from @seeflow/canvas already, so the only barrier really is those two REST helpers. Plan: extend CanvasAdapter in US-024 with optional `openProjectFile?` / `revealProjectFile?` (or fold them into a generic `fileAction` method), then move detail-panel.tsx + detail-panel.test.tsx into packages/canvas/src/components/ in US-028 alongside the rest of the orchestrator.
